top_signals.title: Oil Prices Hold Near Three-Month Lows Despite Hormuz Mine Claims
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices remained subdued in early trading on Tuesday, with Brent trading below $90 per barrel despite Iranian claims that three oil tankers had struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
